title: Now dive in deepness of darkness Which harkens To feats in us Whose light Fills nights with Nothing but broken Shadows. #smallpoems
summary: Now dive in deepness of darkness Which harkens To feats in us Whose light Fills nights with Nothing but broken Shadows. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Now
dive in
deepness of darkness
Which harkens
To feats in us
Whose light
Fills nights with
Nothing but broken
Shadows.

#smallpoems
